info.name: SKYGRID Deployment Broker Controlled Pilot
info.description: Controlled-pilot regression suite for SKYGRID Emergency Data On-Ramp deployment broker. Never commit real admin keys or enrollment tokens.

exec: pm.test('Broker is healthy and fail closed', () => { pm.expect(body.ok).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.product).to.eql('SKYGRID Emergency Data On-Ramp'); pm.expect(body.component).to.eql('deployment_broker'); pm.expect(body.sentinel).to.eql('fail_closed'); pm.expect(body.durable_single_use_store).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('No secrets are exposed', () => { const raw = pm.response.text().toLowerCase(); pm.expect(raw).not.to.include('admin_key'); pm.expect(raw).not.to.include('broker_secret'); });
pm.test('Missing admin key is rejected', () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));

item.name: 03 Reject issuance with wrong admin key

exec: pm.test('Wrong admin key is rejected', () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));
pm.test('Wrong method is not accepted', () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));

pm.test('Issuance contract is complete', () => { pm.expect(body.ok).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.product).to.eql('SKYGRID Emergency Data On-Ramp'); pm.expect(body.mode).to.eql('controlled_pilot'); pm.expect(body.lifecycle_state).to.eql('issued'); pm.expect(body.maximum_uses).to.eql(1); pm.expect(body.no_installation_executed).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.allowed_platforms).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('allowed_platform')); });

const marker = '/enroll/'; const tokenIndex = body.enrollment_url.indexOf(marker); pm.expect(tokenIndex).to.be.above(-1); const token = body.enrollment_url.substring(tokenIndex + marker.length); pm.collectionVariables.set('enrollment_id', body.enrollment_id); pm.collectionVariables.set('enrollment_token', token); pm.collectionVariables.set('tampered_token', token + 'tampered');
const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Platform rejection is explicit', () => { pm.expect(body.ok).to.eql(false); pm.expect(body.reason).to.eql('platform_not_authorized'); });

const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Redemption contract is complete', () => { pm.expect(body.ok).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.event_type).to.eql('enrollment_redemption_approved'); pm.expect(body.enrollment_id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('enrollment_id')); pm.expect(body.lifecycle_state).to.eql('redeemed'); pm.expect(body.platform).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('allowed_platform')); pm.expect(body.no_wallet_signing).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.no_payment_execution).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.no_production_failover).to.eql(true); });

const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Reuse rejection is explicit and safe', () => { pm.expect(body.ok).to.eql(false); pm.expect(body.reason).to.eql('enrollment_link_already_redeemed'); pm.expect(body.enrollment_id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('enrollment_id')); pm.expect(body.no_installation_executed).to.eql(true); });
